$comment: Operator alerts 3/4/5/7-backup from the ops spec (12-operations §6.4), as Axiom monitor definitions. Dataset: spillway-prod (created when the Fly log drain is provisioned). Apply with ./apply-axiom.sh — needs AXIOM_TOKEN. notifierIds are patched in by the script from AXIOM_NOTIFIER_SLACK / AXIOM_NOTIFIER_EMAIL env (IDs exist only after notifiers are created in the Axiom UI).

monitors.name: spillway-alert3-error-rate-spike
monitors.description: Alert 3: >10 error-level log lines in 5 minutes. Field is pino `level` (50 = error) — the spec's prose says error-level; pino serializes it as `level`, not `status`.
monitors.aplQuery: ['spillway-prod'] | where level == 50 | summarize count() by bin(_time, 5m)

monitors.name: spillway-alert4-job-failure
monitors.description: Alert 4: any background-job failure. Matches the job.error log taxonomy (12-operations §5).

monitors.name: spillway-alert5-pricing-sync-stale-36h
monitors.description: Alert 5: no successful pricing-sync finish in 36h. Counts successful finishes in the trailing 36h window — 0 means stale. Daily at the monitor's schedule (~06:00 UTC when created then).
monitors.aplQuery: ['spillway-prod'] | where msg == "job.finish" and job == "pricing-sync" and ok == true | count

monitors.name: spillway-alert7-spend-write-lost-CRITICAL
monitors.description: Alert 7 (backup channel): money not metered — reconcile declared a settle lost after retries. Primary channel is the prom scrape on spillway_spend_write_lost_total; this log match fires even if scraping is down. `startswith`, not ==, per the spec (msg carries a suffix).
